answer_1.quote: We evaluate the models on open-ended Question Answering on the aforementioned prompts ... We perform 90K human evaluations ... on a new set of general and culturally-nuanced prompts created independently by native speakers for each language.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses to open-ended QA prompts in ten Indic languages

answer_3.quote: We also use an LLM (GPT-4-32K) for evaluating the battles as well as providing scores using the direct assessment metrics.

answer_4.quote: Each datapoint is evaluated by three human annotators ... the annotators are provided with the query, the two model responses (model names are hidden), and set of three options -A (response 1 is better), B (response 2 is better), and C (tie). For direct assessment, annotators label linguistic acceptability, task quality and hallucination.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were given guidelines to compare two responses, choose the better one or a tie, and to rate each response on linguistic acceptability, task quality, and hallucination.
